title: Expertise-aware dispatch (Anthropic Claude Code Research 借鉴)
scope:
1. Anthropic Claude Code Research: novice vs expert abandonment gap 19% vs 5-7%, verified success requires hard evidence
2. KALLAX 现状: performer 无 expertise 分层, dispatch 无 mastery awareness, 无 abandonment tracking
3. 3 ticket 并行: A abandonment_rate 指标 / B verified success schema / C expertise-aware dispatch
4. 跟 EPIC-117 Simplicity 联合: expertise-aware dispatch 不是加复杂度, 是让现有规则更精准
5. 4-PR 流程 (feature → testing → main → miao, EPIC-074)
master_explicit_decision: 2026-07-14 主公 explicit '需要' 开 EPIC-118. Anthropic research: expert performer abandonment 5-7% vs novice 19%, expert verified success 28-33% vs novice 15%. KALLAX dispatch 无 expertise awareness, 有改进空间.

checkin_points.gate: 每 PR 含: (a) scope 文件 (b) local test raw output (c) 该 ticket 声明的 acceptance criteria 全绿

tickets.title: abandonment_rate metric — 补缺失的 reliability 指标
tickets.acceptance: abandonment_rate 加入 sprint metrics (target <10%, 计算: abandoned_tickets / assigned_tickets, abandonment=performer 认领后无 PR 且超 48h)

tickets.title: ticket.json schema: mastery_level + verified_commit_sha
tickets.acceptance: ticket.json 新字段: mastery_level (L1/L2/L3), verified_commit_sha (commit SHA 或 null), schema 文档更新

tickets.title: conductor dispatch: expertise-aware checkpoints
tickets.acceptance: task-assigner 根据 performer mastery_level 调整 checkpoints: L1=每子任务必验证 / L2=里程碑验证 / L3=只验收最终 PR
